2461.text: Lots to do, lots to do! The Union's given us deadlines and they're not the sort you want to miss!

2464.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $n!

2527.text: Greetings.  I'm an undead mage trainer, and you're a mage.
2527.text1: Greetings.  I'm an undead mage trainer, and you're a mage.

2529.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?
2529.text1: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

2545.text1: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

2602.text: The Shattered Hand will see the Horde to their former glory, unhindered by the timidness of the Warchief.
2602.text1: The Shattered Hand will see the Horde to their former glory, unhindered by the timidness of the Warchief.

2803.text: At last! Someone to free me from this cell!$b$bHigh Executor Hadrec sent us to gather information on the Keep so that a plan could be formulated to overthrow Arugal once and for all.$b$bBut the old wizard has many tricks up his sleeve and we were detected by a magical ward. I was thrown in this prison. Vincent was not so lucky.$b$bI must return to Hadrec to debrief him at once. But first I will pick the lock to the courtyard door for you. Perhaps you can try your luck against the foes that lurk beyond.

2824.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.
2824.text1: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

2826.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.
2826.text1: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

2974.text: What do you need directions to?
2974.text1: What do you need directions to?

3003.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.
3003.text1: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

3146.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a warrior's time.
3146.text1: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a warrior's time.

3483.text:
There is no finer cook in Thunder Bluff than Aska Mistrunner.  Mmmmm, I can smell what she is cooking from here.  Head over to her kitchen located on the high rise.

Drat... now I am hungry.
3483.text1:
There is no finer cook in Thunder Bluff than Aska Mistrunner.  Mmmmm, I can smell what she is cooking from here.  Head over to her kitchen located on the high rise.

Drat... now I am hungry.

4139.text: Welcome to Blue Moon Odds and Ends, $c.  If you have any questions, please let me know.

4350.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

4617.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.
4617.text1: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

4619.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?
4619.text1: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

4621.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?
4621.text1: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

4635.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.
4635.text1: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

4660.text1: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

5077.text: What do ye need directions to?
5077.text1: What do ye need directions to?

5325.text: Of all the wondrous places within Darnassus, which would you have me direct you to?
5325.text1: Of all the wondrous places within Darnassus, which would you have me direct you to?

5353.text: Here among the craftsmen of Darnassus, there is a millenium of knowledge for the benefit of your chosen craft.  Now tell me, which craft do you find the most intriguing?
5353.text1: Here among the craftsmen of Darnassus, there is a millenium of knowledge for the benefit of your chosen craft.  Now tell me, which craft do you find the most intriguing?

5739.text: I hear one comment about waterfowl, and you will be eating through a tube.

5745.text: I listen and I listen but I don't hear these spirits that Karn speaks of.

5969.text: Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.$B$BPlease, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.$B$BThere are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

6016.text: The Valley of Trials will temper even the weakest into a warrior worthy to join the Horde. Those who cannot rise to its tests will be left to bake in the scorching desert sun.

6070.text: The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.$B$BHe feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

6986.text: What do ye need directions to?
6986.text1: What do ye need directions to?

7214.text: Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.$B$BI deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

7217.text: Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.$B$BIf you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.$B$BBut there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

7218.text: All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $n. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.$B$BIt is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.$B$BUnderstand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

7228.text: Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.$B$BOur great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

7451.text: Welcome, my $g brother : sister;.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.$B$BIt never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.
7451.text1: Welcome, my $g brother : sister;.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.$B$BIt never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.

7460.text: Even within cold, stone walls such as the ones that shelter this town, one may find tranquility and peace.  In fact, you may find them everywhere you are... simply look inside yourself for such balance.
7460.text1: Even within cold, stone walls such as the ones that shelter this town, one may find tranquility and peace.  In fact, you may find them everywhere you are... simply look inside yourself for such balance.

7559.text: Hey mon! You've ever been diving deep in the ocean? I'll let you in on a little secret, eh. Deep in the ocean you can find bubbly fissures; they'll allow you to breathe air while underwater.  Let's keep this secret between you and me though, eh. I don't need no competition for me shellfish traps elsewhere... if you get my drift!

7577.text: Would you like a flight to Thunder Bluff, courtesy of the Cenarion Circle?

7584.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

7607.text1: I should find some hired help; I don't like sitting here all day selling fish supplies. I'd much rather go fishing, and then sell supplies.

7647.text: Do you prefer guns or bows?
7647.text1: Do you prefer guns or bows?

7659.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?
7659.text1: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

7663.text: Da spirits be strong wit you, mon. What kin dis troll do for ya?
7663.text1: Da spirits be strong wit you, mon. What kin dis troll do for ya?

7710.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $n, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

7818.text: You know who can really show you some things? Nogg! You go find him in Orgrimmar.

7899.text: If you seek to hunt naga, then you will need all the help you can get. Deep in the water you can find bubbly fissures that produce enough air bubbles that will allow you to breath underwater. Swim up close so that you can use the bubbles.

7941.text: You have reached new heights in your path to mastery. Let us see if we can take you even further...

7970.text: The caverns below us are a source of strange and wondrous hides, but you must take care if you venture into their depths, $n. Remember that your own skin is far more valuable.

8020.text: You won't learn anything new from me; you know too much already. If you want more training, talk to the tauren Una in the northwestern shops of Thunder Bluff's central plateau. Send her my regards, eh?

8089.text: I am afraid that I am no longer gentle or humble. Age and countless battles have hardened my skin and soul. Perhaps that is why Cairne assigned me to Sun Rock Retreat... the gentle winds and warm sun does ease the pain.

8094.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

8095.text: How may I be of service?

8102.text: It is my honor to provide for adventurers, for they are heroes in the making.

8108.text:
This dock here? Well, you can catch the ship that goes to Southshore, and then stops at that night elf place after. What's its name? Uhh... Auberdine, I think.

I don't really know for sure, I just load and unload stuff.

8111.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

8116.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

8120.text: Have a look at my meats, friend.  You won't want to go out into the Barrens without a good stock of provisions.

8122.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

8146.text1: Do you hear the call of the hunt, $c?  You must listen closely, but the call comes from deep within you.  It comes from deep within all of us.

8243.text: Greeting $c - welcome to the front lines in our conquest of Ashenvale!  If you are looking for something to do, then you've come to the right place.  I'm always looking for able-bodied individuals to help bring glory to the Horde!

8257.text: If you want to know about the comings and goings of caravans and merchants here in Splintertree Post, then I am fortunately the orc you are looking for.  Unfortunately for you though, I don't like people.$B$BIf you want something, make it quick.

8258.text: The elements speak to us, $c.  They share knowledge that we must learn, and they share secrets that must be kept.

8263.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.
8263.text1: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

8289.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $n.
8289.text1: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $n.

8293.text: $n, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?
8293.text1: $n, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?

8330.text: Stonetalon Mountain has many perilous caves through out this region.  Exploring these caves can hold many adventures for those willing to risk life for glory.$B$B$C, perhaps you seek riches that only following your heart and soul can garnish.

8777.text1: This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.

9551.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.
9551.text1: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

9556.text: You will need to find Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh to get any better than you are currently.
9556.text1: You will need to find Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh to get any better than you are currently.

9686.text: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.
9686.text1: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.

9891.text: Hail $g brother : sister;... I'd like a moment of your time, if I may.$B$BWe tauren have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing our homeland.  We now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of tauren everywhere in helping us out!

10029.text: Where can I send you today $c?

10031.text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  Wherever you decide to travel, may she watch over you.

10032.text: Treat the wind rider well as it takes you to your destination.  May your ancestors watch over you $n.

10753.text: Where would you like to fly to?
10753.text1: Where would you like to fly to?

10863.text: War is upon us, $n.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

11865.text: Can I show you what I have for sale?

250597.text1: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

296783.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

302815.text:
The spirits of the wind may have left us, but the power of the elements is not entirely out of reach for those with the patience to seek them out.

If you are initiated in the ways of the shaman, I can help you grasp them.
302815.text1:
The spirits of the wind may have left us, but the power of the elements is not entirely out of reach for those with the patience to seek them out.

If you are initiated in the ways of the shaman, I can help you grasp them.

304010.text: What do you need of me, child of Zephras?

304012.text1: What may I do for you, fellow windshaper?

305322.text1:
Greetings and well met, $n! Your arrival is timely, and we here at the Durotar Supply and Logistics company are always in need of new contractors.

If you are someone with a knack for gathering useful materials or the skills to craft something from scratch, you have a place here.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

306593.text: <The gaze of the ranger standing before you is fixed on the enormous anchor pylon in the distance.>
306593.text1: <The gaze of the ranger standing before you is fixed on the enormous anchor pylon in the distance.>

309857.text1:
Please do not touch the vials unless you intend to purchase one.

Fingerprints ruin the value, you see.

309859.text: Oh! Greetings, friend. Feel free to browse my wares.

309862.text:
<Jim'bek locks eyes with you as he takes a deep puff from his hookah.>

'Ello, mon. Need a rug? A blanket? Or just some cloth for your next project? I got you.

310718.text: Are you in need of a weapon, traveler? You'll not find a finer blade anywhere, I assure you.
310718.text1: Are you in need of a weapon, traveler? You'll not find a finer blade anywhere, I assure you.

310720.text: I thought you were dead, Terry.
310720.text1: I thought you were dead, Terry.

310721.text: No, Walt, I'm still alive. That shot you took at me back in Ratchet only missed my heart by an inch.
310721.text1: No, Walt, I'm still alive. That shot you took at me back in Ratchet only missed my heart by an inch.

310722.text: Well, not much chance I'd miss at this range.
310722.text1: Well, not much chance I'd miss at this range.

310723.text: You might have failed to notice that you are outnumbered.
310723.text1: You might have failed to notice that you are outnumbered.

310724.text: It seems you've made some fast friends, Walt. This orc filth refused to give you up. If only he knew how little loyalty means to you.
310724.text1: It seems you've made some fast friends, Walt. This orc filth refused to give you up. If only he knew how little loyalty means to you.

310725.text: I can't do that. You know what happens to deserters. Put your rifle down and come peacefully... or don't. The bounty is "dead or alive" and I still owe you for Ratchet.
310725.text1: I can't do that. You know what happens to deserters. Put your rifle down and come peacefully... or don't. The bounty is "dead or alive" and I still owe you for Ratchet.

310726.text: It's not about loyalty. It's about honor. That orc knows more about honor than the Lord Admiral ever did. That's why I left.
310726.text1: It's not about loyalty. It's about honor. That orc knows more about honor than the Lord Admiral ever did. That's why I left.

310728.text: It looks like they've got Vrang with them. These bastards...
310728.text1: It looks like they've got Vrang with them. These bastards...

310729.text: Just so--no matter how fast these thugs are, my first shot is aimed at you.
310729.text1: Just so--no matter how fast these thugs are, my first shot is aimed at you.

310730.text: Listen to me, Terry, just take these men and leave. Tell Benedict or whomever sent you that I'm dead. Walk away.
310730.text1: Listen to me, Terry, just take these men and leave. Tell Benedict or whomever sent you that I'm dead. Walk away.

310749.text: Sorry if they roughed you up, Vrang. If I had known they got you, I'd have come running.
310749.text1: Sorry if they roughed you up, Vrang. If I had known they got you, I'd have come running.

310750.text: Is it true--you deserted your brothers in arms?
310750.text1: Is it true--you deserted your brothers in arms?

310751.text: Yes, Vrang, it is true. When Daelin Proudmoore took control of Theramore, he did terrible things. Dishonorable things that I could not be a part of.
310751.text1: Yes, Vrang, it is true. When Daelin Proudmoore took control of Theramore, he did terrible things. Dishonorable things that I could not be a part of.

310752.text: I see. I can respect a man who values his honor and does not compromise his convictions.
310752.text1: I see. I can respect a man who values his honor and does not compromise his convictions.

310775.text: Watch your step making the climb up the ridge. It can be quite treacherous.
310775.text1: Watch your step making the climb up the ridge. It can be quite treacherous.

311861.text: What can these old bones do for you, $c? Perhaps you would like to hear of a troll legend?

312713.text: It can get boring up here, you know. I can only annoy that stuffy wretch Halaan so much before even that gets old.
312713.text1: It can get boring up here, you know. I can only annoy that stuffy wretch Halaan so much before even that gets old.

312724.text: You there! Be careful! Your sacred shen'dorei gifts are not to be used for amusement!

313796.text1:
Welcome to Dalaran, $c. 

Please pay no mind to some of the construction that is still underway. Oh, and should you encounter a rogue arcane anomaly, demon, or other malign entity, please feel free to seek assistance from the nearest member of the Kirin Tor before fleeing--um... proceeding--to the nearest exit in an orderly fashion!

<Arcanist Laurain laughs nervously.>

Thank you for visiting!

317058.text: Well, well... are you ready to fight for the Horde in Darkspear Islands?
317058.text1: Well, well... are you ready to fight for the Horde in Darkspear Islands?

318599.text1: You came. I'll admit, I'm surprised.

318641.text: How do you do, fellow Dalaranian? Sure is a lotta ruckus today, eh?
318641.text1: How do you do, fellow Dalaranian? Sure is a lotta ruckus today, eh?

320585.text: Go to the cleft of shadow and seek out Spellweaver Mon'ye there, near the center of the district.
320585.text1: Go to the cleft of shadow and seek out Spellweaver Mon'ye there, near the center of the district.

320922.text1:
You've likely heard that Dalaran is suffering from a magical outbreak, and all of our mages are too preoccupied maintaining the city's wards to effectively contain it.

I'd do anything to protect my city, $r. Even consorting with the likes of you.

321007.text1: Oh, Jornah should be somewhere around the camp. If you have questions, she would be happy to answer them.

321055.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?
321055.text1:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

324028.text: The sharpest shears and most delicate hands are found at Curls and Furls here in the trade district. Take a gander if you have some spare time and are interested in taking a little off the top.
324028.text1: The sharpest shears and most delicate hands are found at Curls and Furls here in the trade district. Take a gander if you have some spare time and are interested in taking a little off the top.

324030.text: In the Cleft of Shadow Kor'ghan is waiting with shears sharper than a guard's sword.
324030.text1: In the Cleft of Shadow Kor'ghan is waiting with shears sharper than a guard's sword.

325094.text:
My blades don't glisten, glitter, or gleam, and they'll sing no epic songs about my creations when I'm gone. 

One thing you can be sure of though is that my weapons will cut down all the knights in Stormwind before losing their honed edge.
325094.text1:
My blades don't glisten, glitter, or gleam, and they'll sing no epic songs about my creations when I'm gone. 

One thing you can be sure of though is that my weapons will cut down all the knights in Stormwind before losing their honed edge.

328220.text:
Ah, need a wee trim do ye? It's been a bit fer me as well. I might head that way after my shift!

Ye can find the barber northwest from the entrance to Ironforge.
328220.text1:
Ah, need a wee trim do ye? It's been a bit fer me as well. I might head that way after my shift!

Ye can find the barber northwest from the entrance to Ironforge.

328240.text:
Ah, are you looking perhaps to change your markings, or prepare for a hunt? There is no better place.

You will find the barber in the Tradesman's Terrace, near the auction house.
328240.text1:
Ah, are you looking perhaps to change your markings, or prepare for a hunt? There is no better place.

You will find the barber in the Tradesman's Terrace, near the auction house.

328288.text: Look on the lower rise opposite the auctioneers if you would like to get your mane trimmed.
328288.text1: Look on the lower rise opposite the auctioneers if you would like to get your mane trimmed.

329279.text: The eccentric, often brilliant gnomes, are held as one of the most peculiar races of the world.
